scripts.dev: npm run build -w @aniforge/shared && concurrently -k -n api,web "npm run dev -w @aniforge/api" "npm run dev -w @aniforge/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @aniforge/shared && npm run build -w @aniforge/api && npm run build -w @aniforge/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @aniforge/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present && tsc -p tsconfig.tooling.json
scripts.dev:emulators: npm run build -w @aniforge/shared && node scripts/emulators.mjs dev
scripts.test:emulators: npm run build -w @aniforge/shared && node scripts/emulators.mjs test
